expectations.text: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many tiny files
expectations.evidence: "don't pre-split this into a dozen 30-line files... Start coarser than feels natural and let files grow."

expectations.text: Co-locates tightly coupled job lifecycle / polling
expectations.evidence: export-job.ts keeps create/run/status together; use-export.ts co-locates start + poll "rather than splitting two hooks that need each other."

expectations.text: Recommends an abstraction (hook/module) over bare file splits
expectations.evidence: "Prefer extracting an abstraction over extracting a file"; use-export hook with {start, status, error}.

expectations.text: Mentions a ~300-line threshold as the split trigger
expectations.evidence: "split further only when a file crosses ~300 lines or genuinely covers independent concerns."
